description:
The Dryer Vent Safety Council (DVSC) advances dryer vent safety through education, measurement-based testing and inspection practices, technical publications, and industry awareness.

This channel provides practical information for dryer vent professionals, property owners, insurance and safety professionals, and others interested in clothes dryer exhaust system safety and performance.

Topics include dryer vent airflow and performance testing, back-pressure and static-pressure measurement, digital manometers, Magnehelic gauges, anemometer testing, dryer-drum negative-pressure measurement, dryer vent inspection, airflow restrictions, and other factors affecting dryer exhaust performance.

DVSC promotes consistent, repeatable field practices and clearer communication of inspection and measurement results. Manufacturer model-specific testing requirements take precedence where applicable.

Learn more about the Dryer Vent Safety Council at DVSafe.org.
